description: This file contains a class 'AllureSetup' in C# that manages setup and teardown processes for Allure reporting in a test suite. It ensures the results directory exists, writes environment properties, and performs cleanup operations related to Allure artifacts in a NUnit testing environment.

classes.name: AllureSetup
classes.description: A sealed class decorated with SetUpFixture that provides global setup and teardown for Allure reporting in NUnit tests. It manages environment properties and results directory lifecycle.

methods.name: ResolveResultsDir
methods.description: Determines the directory where Allure results should be stored, checking environment variables and test parameters before defaulting to a relative path.

methods.name: WriteEnvironmentProperties
methods.description: Writes a set of environment properties to the 'environment.properties' file within the results directory, including suite info and UI/API settings.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Performs initial setup before the tests run: resolves the results directory, ensures it exists, configures environment variables, and writes initial environment properties.

methods.name: GlobalTearDown
methods.description: Performs cleanup after all tests have run: attempts to write minimal Allure results as a safety fallback.
